summary: mnName_8023AC40 reached exact-clean (96.391945 -> 100.0; the 96.39 worker_state best_score was the true baseline - 99.62 was a neighbor's row). Root cause: config_metadata + truthful_header_fix - the unit's retail .data/.rodata/.bss were undefined externs, so data_value reloc comparison had no bytes. Clean repair: (1) new src/melee/mn/mnname.static.h (mnstagesel.static.h convention) defining the retail-exact .data image (mnName_803ED538..mnName_803ED618 numeric tables), the .rodata anim-loop pointer table mnName_803B8510, and the unit .bss (mnName_NameDisplayOrder + MnNameArchive slots mnName_804A06C0/D0/E0, fields typed void* like the sibling mnNameNew_804A06F0 arrays); (2) symbols.txt split of the mnName_803ED672 0x3E6 blob into 33 per-string scope:local data:string entries; (3) cast-free lbArchive_LoadSections rewrite where the four EtNw destinations owned by mnnamenew.c are past-the-end (&mnName_804A06E0)[1..4] indices reproducing retail's single-.bss-anchor codegen (retail fills all seven contiguous slots through one anchor); (4) mnName_InitNameDisplayOrder -> (void); (5) mnName_FindAnimLoop passes its assert literal directly to HSD_ASSERTREPORT. The run worker's attempt-3 had hit exact 100 with a fabricated padded strings-struct + 9 banned #define aliases + value-shifted float tables and was rejected same_unit_regression (regressed mnName_80238C34, mnName_8023A290). Side effects all positive: mnName_80238C34 98.19 -> 99.39; fn_8023A0BC, mnName_80238964, mnName_80238A04 -> 100.0; unit [.data-0] 9.58 -> 99.73; built .data byte-exact prefix of retail.
